notes: Stage arithmetic medians use the mean of the middle pair for eight observations. The benchmark runner uses its own documented lower quantile for p50. Do not equate these different definitions.
Source ranges run concurrently: the recorded source_ranges_parallel stage is their elapsed time, not their sum.
Worker clocks can remain fixed during CPU work. Zero decode/render durations do not measure CPU.
Stream profile headers are sent before final rendering and omit its final events. Native CPU and Cloudflare platform CPU are separate evidence.
Physical R2 cache and Helius cache states are unknown.
The separate stage pass followed the main benchmark; do not subtract stage medians from main request medians.
